title: 第11章 光月之核，源于虚空，归于寂灭
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
而安怜是S级的光月觉醒者。

    光月元素的核心能力有三个，治愈、封印、感知。

    治愈就不用说了，光月觉醒者拥有全大陆最强的治愈能力，只要还有一口气，就能把人从死神手里抢回来。

    战场上有一个光月在，伤亡率能降低百分之七十以上。

    封印能力则更偏向于控制。

    光月觉醒者可以制造封印阵，封印阵的范围和强度取决于觉醒者的魔力水平和天赋评级。

    SSS级的光月觉醒者，理论上可以封印一座城市的魔力循环系统，让整座城市的魔法防御阵瘫痪。

    感知能力是光月元素最基础也是最常用的能力。

    光月觉醒者可以通过释放魔力场，感知周围一定范围内的生命气息、魔力波动、以及物体的空间位置。

    安怜把课本合上，手指摩挲着封面的皮质纹理。

    这三个技能里，她用得最应心得手的是感知和治愈。

    尤其是感知能力，简直像是为她量身定做的一般。

    虽然她看不见，但她能清晰地感知到周围环境的轮廓以及人的位置和情绪，这让她的生活几乎和常人无异，甚至在某些方面比普通人更敏锐。

    但对于封印能力，她始终不得要领。也不知道是原主天资有缺，还是因为她自己学不来。

    每个月的封印考试，她都是倒数，而且还是老师放水让她踩着线及格的倒数。

    为了拿到最高等的奖学金，她苦学了两个月，结果连最基础的封印阵都画得歪歪扭扭，一点长进都没有。

    安怜叹了口气，旋即用力地摇摇头。

    不能叹气，不能叹气，她是最棒的！

    打气完毕，安怜翻出今天需要翻译的文稿。
content_en:
And An Lian is an S-level Awakener of Light and Moon.

    There are three core abilities of Light and Moon Elements: healing, sealing, and perception.

    Needless to say about healing, the Awakened Ones of Light and Moon have the strongest healing ability in the entire continent. As long as they still have a breath, they can snatch people back from the hands of the God of Death.

    With a light on the battlefield, the casualty rate can be reduced by more than 70%.

    The sealing ability is more focused on control.

    The Light Moon Awakener can create a sealing array. The range and strength of the sealing array depend on the Awakener's magic level and talent rating.

    SSS-level Light and Moon Awakeners can theoretically seal a city's magic circulation system and paralyze the entire city's magic defense array.

    Perception is the most basic and commonly used ability of the light and moon elements.

    Awakeners of Light and Moon can sense the breath of life, magic power fluctuations, and the spatial position of objects within a certain range around them by releasing magic fields.

    An Lian closed the textbook and rubbed the leather texture of the cover with her fingers.

    Among these three skills, the ones she uses most readily are perception and healing.

    Especially the perception ability, it is as if it is tailor-made for her.

    Although she cannot see, she can clearly perceive the outline of the surrounding environment as well as people's positions and emotions, which makes her life almost the same as ordinary people, and even more sensitive than ordinary people in some aspects.

    But she still couldn't figure out the sealing ability. I don’t know if it’s because the original owner lacked talent or because she couldn’t learn it on her own.

    She was counting down every month for the seal exam, and it was because the teacher had let her step on the line to pass.

    In order to get the highest scholarship, she studied hard for two months. As a result, even the most basic sealing formation was painted crookedly, without making any progress at all.

    An Lian sighed, then shook her head vigorously.

    Can't sigh, can't sigh, she is the best!

    After cheering up, An Lian pulled out the manuscript that needed to be translated today.
title_en: Chapter 11 The core of light and moon originates from the void and returns to death.
